paragraphs.text: A shared board for stations, workflows and projects in DeepSeek Harness. No server, no database — Gi
tHub is the access gate.
# CollaborationBoard
Deutsch · **English** · Español · Français · Русский · 日本語 · العربية · 中文

The board is a public workshop and a private workspace at once: people create
projects, work on them

, and see what others are doing. There is no service in
between, no database and no separate sign-in

. The harness is the process, Git is
the store, and GitHub is where rights and collaboration live.
## What the board is

Stations, workflows, projects and boards are separate Git repositories; the
public ones sit under th
e `DeepCollaboration` organization:

- **Station** — one step of work: what goes in, what comes out, how it runs,
with examples and limit

s. Its anchor file is `station.json`.
- **Workflow** — a composition of stations with an order, bran

ches and rules.
Its anchor file is `workflow.json`; it points to a specific version of a
station ins

tead of copying it.
- **Project** — the concrete work on a workflow: name, position, who is
responsi

ble at each step, files and transcripts. Its anchor file is
`vorhaben.json`.
- **Board** — a reposit

ory full of references: which workflows, projects and
stations a person or a team uses. The public *

*main board** is the start page;
next to it there are team boards and local boards without a remote.

The plugin assembles the surface from these repositories. It owns no content:
what you see is in the

repositories, and what you change is recorded there as a
new version.
## Install
Requirement: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with Node 24 and Git.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The plugin is installed into the `web` profile and enabled there. Restart DSH
afterwards; the page a

ppears in the sidebar. The profile's configuration lives
under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/` — nothing t
here needs to be entered by hand.
### If the plugin does not start

The common cases with cause and fix are in
docs/fehlersuche.md.

If DSH reports “Failed to load plugins” with `@local/dsh-board: failed` at
startup, the client has r

ead a dashboard service without registering it. The
board needs `slots` (the places in the interface

) and `locale` (the language);
both are listed in `client.js` under `inject`. If one is missing, DSH

aborts the
plugin's startup instead of loading it without the service.

A guard in the code does not help here: the read itself throws. The fix is one
line — add the servic

e to `inject`, restart DSH. `test/markt47.mjs` checks the
list and fails with the same message when
a service is missing.
## First start
On first start the board fetches the public main board by itself:

- It clones `https://github.com/DeepCollaboration/board-hauptboard` to
`$DSH_HOME/board/cache/DeepCo

llaboration/board-hauptboard`.
- It enters the main board in `$DSH_HOME/board/boards.json` and opens

it.
- It fetches the stations, workflows and projects the main board points to
into the same cache.

They then live under
`$DSH_HOME/board/cache/DeepCollaboration/<repository>`.

An existing registry with other boards stays untouched. Without a network the
entry remains and says

“not fetched”; the page offers a button to retry, and the
rest of the board stays usable.

**Reading needs no name.** After the first start the main board, its stations,
the catalog and the P

robeprojekt are open. You can browse, open files and read
conversations. You only need a name of you

r own when you join, contribute, or
want a board of your own.
### Fresh install: reading is free, creating needs a token

1. **Install.** The command is above under **Install**; restart DSH afterwards.
2. **Open.** Open th

e board in the sidebar. On first start the main board is
already fetched and registered.
3. **Read.*

* The main board, stations, workflow, catalog and the Probeprojekt
are open without a name and witho

ut a token. While there is no write
permission, the board bar shows **Read only** with the reason be

low it; the
library can still be browsed.
4. **Create only with a token.** The **Create station** bu

tton appears only once
a token is stored and an owner is known. Store the token under
**Settings → B

oard → GitHub**; without it the board stays readable, but no
new stations are created. The response

to an attempt to create explains this
path.

The catalog searches public stations with the topic `dsh-board-station` even
without signing in. Wha

t you find you can read and put into a workflow; only the
reference is written.
## The interface

Everything happens on one page: a header across the top, a rail on the left,
docks beside it, and th
e canvas in the middle.

- **Header** — the board on the left, the title in the middle, the people and
the page's tools on th

e right, including the station search. A status line
below it says what the page has to say and disa

ppears when there is nothing.
- **Rail** — a narrow column on the left that is always visible. It ho

lds the
**Library** and the **History**; a small companion sits there and reacts to
“done” and to er

rors.
- **Dock** — the left dock opens the library or the history; its content scrolls
while its hea

der stays. The right dock shows the open station and the
conversation, with tabs when both are open

at once. Drag the left edge of the
right dock to make it wider or narrower.
- **Canvas** — the free

surface with cards and connections. Drag stations and
projects, connect stations, hand a project on

to the next step. What you move
stays where you put it in **Free** layout.
- **Open station** — clic

k a station on the canvas or in the library. The right
dock shows its name and version, what goes in

and what comes out, and how it
runs.
- **Conversation** — a conversation at a station runs in the r

ight dock and
shows questions and answers as they are written — the same text that later
appears in

the transcript. Close the column and the conversation continues in
the chat.
## Your own board

In the main board open the library and switch to **Catalog** at the top. There
is the **Probeprojekt

** — the sample project, a public project at the “Idee”
station. The **Import into my Board** button

project, a public project at the “Idee”
station. The **Import into my Board** button starts the way:
